Messages.Author: b.ja...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
The matter is this card:

Groundfighting

[Combat] Combat

Requires a ready anarch. Do not replace until after combat.
Maneuver or press or burn 1 blood to cancel a combat card played by
the opposing minion that would restrict this anarch's choice of
strikes this round as it is played.

Artist(s): Chris Richards

Can it cancel Thoughts Betrayed? My feeling is yes, since it
explicitly limits the choice of strike, but i want some confirmation.

But the problem is also the frenzy cards, they prevent me of choosing
weapons as a strike, so restricting my anarch choice of strikes. But
its kinda loophole in all this situation, and my judgement is kinda
blurry here. Can you explicitly rule out this?

Messages.Author: niko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:


It cancels all of those, yes.

But that got me thinking. Since some cards require a specific range,
Taste of Death, Sewer Lid etc. would a card that sets the range to
short count as limiting my choice of strike? I assume no, even though
it DOES limit it indirectly, since otherwise setting the range to long
would limit my choice of all close range strikes, and then maneuvering
to long would do the same!
AND THEN GROUNDFIGHTING WOULD BE A BIT TOO GOOD! :)

Messages.Author: PaulW...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:


Manoeuvring to long range doesn't limit your choice of strikes at all.
You are still perfectly able to throw a punch. That you are unable to
hit your opponent is a different issue.
Cards that says opponent cannot, opponent must, only this/that etc.
are cards that can be cancelled with groundfighting.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
See "Groundifghting" in the rulings list for links to the posts where these
rulings are discussed in greater detail.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=rulings

Groundfighting:
# Can cancel Drawing Out the Beast (or other "target cannot use equipment" card)
if the target has a weapon. [LSJ 20050221]
# Can cancel superior Thoughts Betrayed and Shape Mastery (when the latter is
used to cancel a strike) [LSJ 20050222] [LSJ 20050223]
# Cannot cancel maneuvering, setting range, burning blood, Scorpion Sting (or
other "cannot be dodged" strikes, since the opposing minion is still free to
attempt to dodge), Weakness, destroy/steal equipment/weapon effects, Withering,
Fata Amria, [LSJ 20050221] [LSJ 20050221] [LSJ 20050223] [LSJ 20050223]
# Cannot cancel restricting the ability to strike and/or gain additional strikes
(e.g., Rigor Mortis, Lapse) [LSJ 20050221] [LSJ 20050222] [LSJ 20050223]
